wikitext:
== Update, June 11, 2025 ==

* Added new [[Command line arguments|command line parameter]] "-nopatchui".
** Your client will patch invisibly in the background, until it has enough content to show the [[login screen]], at which time the login window will appear on-screen.
** If combined with "-image", your client will fully patch, and then proceed to the login screen.
** This is similar to the option available in [[Guild Wars 2]].
* Fixed a bug that would prevent the game from running on certain Microsoft Surface Tablet computers.
** Occasional graphic glitches are visible, usually as large black extended triangles, when using the new graphics chip in these tablets, the Qualcomm® Adreno™ GPU.
